method: Union of local candidate group labels and only explicitly tagged shared_core cross-topic edges; variant unitats:6 kept distinct; problematic mixed variants pitagores:15 and superficies:17 isolated; problems types initially distinct unless shared_core evidence
warnings: These are working clusters, not pedagogical families; transitivity can overmerge despite strict evidence
One cluster does not imply one distinct family or a single N1/N2/N3 level
No curricular certification, no UI validation, no approval or deployment
Merging shared_core edges is a review hypothesis, not an automatic decision
review_gates: Inspect all working clusters for false positive transitive mergers
Compare at least two actual generator instances per candidate
Record curricular learning objective and difficulty evidence for N1,N2,N3
Validate guided, autonomous, exam and worksheet modes before approvals
Never update families-validades.json or production from this catalogue
